text: I've had this game since day one and at first thought it was one of the best mobile games ever. However it's quickly become stale, in comparison to an excellent mobile game such as fire emblem heroes it severely lacks in things to do. After a week or so you'll find yourself simply logging on everyday to do a daily summon and that's it. Nothing new has been added in weeks that doesn't take 5 minutes to complete. This wouldn't be a huge issue if the price for crystals wasn't eye watering. It simply is not worth it as it is a gacha game meaning you pull the lever and you might get what you want but there's a small chance you will. I really enjoyed this game when it first came out but they've unfortunately become so greedy they've pushed me away to other games. Hopefully they listen and sorth themselves out.

Awesome. Amazing animations, good fun (and simple) gameplay. Smooth menu system and not too many currencies (there is quite a few though). Outside of the core game there's training (with loads of options), "adventures", which I find over kill. All in all its a great time killer, play for hours or minutes, it's still fun. This unfortunately isn't dragon ball FighterZ, that, on mobile would be amazing!

Amazing game. Would recommend it to anyone who likes good graphics, dragon ball in general and for people who like stories. Story mode is nicely laid out and the controls are simple. I would have to say that luck plays a major role since chrono chrystals are hard to get for players who finished the story mode since there aren't many ways to get Chrono chrystals other than story mode. When you finally have enough for a summon, I often find you don't get many sparking units but still a fun game.

The game froze after reaching level 31. Took 9 hours to solve. But thankfully. I can continue to play a game I'm enjoying. I like how different this game is to all the rest I've played. Its style of gameplay is unique on its own. Making this possibly 1 of the better DB games out. I would have rated 5 stars if it wasn't for that level 31 glitch I encountered. But this game is worth downloading for sure!

Love the game. Minor addiction I'll admit. Great for fans of the dragonball series. My only reason for this not being a 5* is that the games seems to be moving more toward pay to win. I play on a daily basis grinding away at the various missions and current events to unlock as much as I can, often to find that summons do not yield the latest power characters. Doesn't always happen this way, but the only way for me to get some of these new more powerful players would be to pay for more chronos.

THIS GAME IS SO FUN!!! The game is amazing because of the realistic graphics the speech sounds like the real characters and there are some great characters ready to be used in battle!!!! But the only bad thing I dislike about the game is where are the other packs we need more packs I know it's only just came out but still all we need is at least 1 extra pack so it's more exciting, please take my advice and add a new pack in but besides that the game is the best I've played in my life!!!!

Easily the best Dragonball game on mobile, heck it's probably one of the best games on mobile. Great graphics and gameplay, lore to the game, strategies and additional story to the Dragonball universe. My only gripe to the game is the expense of in game purchases. It's way too hard to get the LF characters without having to put some money in, 1 summon costs average 100CC and for 1000CC it's £24, that's half the price of a AAA console game. For a CHANCE of getting a character. Ridiculous.

Okay so I've been playing this for a while and now have decided to review. The game is extremely balanced you don't need to worry about someone having super strong characters when you go against them. The Controls are extremely easy to learn and after practice you can get really good the only disappointing thing for me is when there is a character your trying to get who is Sparking or Extreme rarity you can't get them, and that's where in app purchases come in even though you don't need to do in app purchases it is recommended so you can make your characters extremely strong. I would recommend this game to people but wouldnt recommend doing in app purchases because I have found ways to make my characters strong without them for about a year now

The game is really good and would suggest it to everyone. Everything from the gameplay to the characters are stunning. There is only one thing, in some of the new Legends Limited summons, the chances of getting the new OP character is 5% whereas the others are like 0.58%. When I do the summon, I get the 0.58% characters instead of the new one. Maybe it's just luck. I think they should just boost the chances. :)

I LOVE this game. It flows well, good graphics and gameplay, and I just adore the story. But the loot system in this game needs SO much more work. It costs 1,000 gems to get a bulk pack to unlock characters. Any player reading this will understand how hard 1,000 is to earn (not buy). So when I buy a bulk pack for characters, I don't think it fair that I'm "rewarded" with nothing but low tier characters. Not just once, but multiple time. Please developers. Fix your random loot generator.

Very good game with over a hundred different units from the anime, including GT! My main issue is how the game craps on players if they refuse to spend money on the overpriced chrono crystals so you can open loot boxes that rarely give you anything good. I spend a full 4 hours grinding for 1 summon so I can get 7 heroics and 3 extremes. Nice. Effort should be rewarded, not discouraged. The 14 star system only exists so they can spam dupes and justify it. The game is made entirely for cash grabs.

I love the game! It's great but the PVP matches are a little annoying as you try to dodge the attack when the ! Comes up but it doesn't let you due to the game being slow at times. Another one is when you spend all the Diamonds you have on a summon and you get like 30 Hero characters and 20 Extreme characters and 1 Spark. You need to spend money as per to get anywhere but I refuse! Other than that it's pretty decent. I spent all my gems to get the new Goku and it crashed when I got him.

Truth be told, this game is amazing and it has really surprised me these 2 years, but the game is too repetitive and I'm tired of getting shafted, grinding for cc and getting shafted over and over again. There are also little ways of getting cc in the game, too little events, and PvP is just disgusting right now (Whales). Don't get me wrong the rest of the features of the game are really good but you guys needs to change some stuff up a bit. This is my reason for 3 stars.

I've played this game alot in the 4 to 5 months I've had it and I can honestly say it is one of my favourite games not just on mobile but in general. The graphics are great, the characters are well designed and simple, the story and main character (shallot) are awesome and I love his character development throughout the story and the customisation of him, and it's FREE. The summon rates are annoying sometimes but it's understandable. Definitely get this game.

a great game and have a problem putting it down, but PvP seems to be dominated by players who pay to win and the training of characters has been rushed in the recent updates. would also like to see the summons change as well, maybe with some different villains. overall though the story is engaging and the game really can keep you occupied for hours.

Best game ever,I don't get why people are complaining and saying that you have to spend loadsmof money, thus is a false statement. I haven't spent a penny on this game and I have , so many brilliant sparking characters. To the 1s that say you have to spend alot of time in the game yes it's true but it's fun and the story keeps on going. You think you've completed it then the game makers add extra episodes, an excellent way of keeping you interested in the game. It's the cartoon but playable.

A brilliant game that works nicely and updates regularly to keep it interesting. Controls are simple to learn and satisfying to master. Haven't had the need to spend any money on it as you can earn plenty of crystals to see you through the game. Pvp is great but occasionally a bit laggy and rare characters are frustrating to come by but that's why they are rare I guess. A really great game over all.

Not as good as Dokkan Battle. Legends is a good game but it falls short in several categories. The combat is very simple and gets boring after a while. The summons are the worst part of the game because the rates are always trash. On the other hand, The card art is absolutely spectacular and the inclusion of KaggyFilms playing Shallot was a good one.

Overall very fun just find the free to play aspect a bit lacking once you've played the game for a while and getting the currency used to summon takes a while. With increasingly stronger units with it getting harder and harder to summon most of the time it can be hard to keep up with the new content while getting everything I want which can be frustrating

This game was legit incredible. I haven't came across a gem like this in awhile. Everything about this, is created to a high standard. From the superb graphics and soundtrack, to the story telling and actual fighting mechanics themselves. It is a game you have to play. Nice change of pace from all the pay to win garbage out there. If you enjoy Dragon Ball Z through Super, or fighting games with a slightly more chill and strategic play style. Then this, is the game for you.

Great game with solid battle mechanics, if you could incorporate a concept where we get a sparking every multi that would be great. Helps f2p players and those who cant afford to sink hundreds into a mobile game as pvp is literally a feature for the wallet whales. Also it would be an idea to add a cycle of equipment to the trade shop, every other day or week the shop will cycle to a new set of equipment for purchase. Just a thought.

Brilliant graphics, surprisingly fun gameplay. Only downside is that there's SO MANY loading screens, there's even loading screens within loading screens...and the UI is a little cluttered and complex. Plus way too many in-game items that are poorly explained and hard to figure out where, when and how they should be used. In a nutshell, simplify the game a bit.

Great graphics for a phone game, slight niggles though the worst niggle for me is that some of the guidelines told to you to follow don't always work as well as they should in battle like which colours do more damage to other colours (colours of characters) so when I think I've got the upper hand on a certain colour THEY'RE STILL RAINING IN ALL THIS DAMAGE!-and I'm like what!?-how can you do *THIS* much damage when it's me who has the better colour and mine is fully maxed and yours is not!-???

It's overall a great game. It's action packed,great graphics,not that complex of a game and animations are smooth and sleek. The only thing that would be nice for the game is an offline mode. There are times I'm out doing something and I want to grind some Chrono Shards but I can't and I don't want to usey data. I think there should be a feature where story mode and summons etc should be available without internet. But that aside it's a amazing game and this is just a suggestion for the game

Great game with plenty of rewards for simply playing, my only main issue is something you can entirely ignore and that's the pricing of the Chrono Crystals, they cost far too much for far too little, the conversion rate is a real turn off for me ever wanting to spend money on it, however in spite of that this game succeeds at being a fun game to play and a satisfying gatcha game!

It's great for me. The characters are cool. The gameplay is awesome, and summoning is cool as well. but my one problem is when I do , let's say 5 missions, I click collect all or something like that it takes a good like 1 - 2 seconds before I can do anything on the game. But yeah, great game. I recommend getting it , its awesome.

I love dragon ball legends. It's a fun game and has an interesting story with lots of other stuff and it's just really cool. The fact that you can train soul boost and upgrade many characters is amazing. One thing I would say is that the game is so big and takes lots of space on my device disallowing me to play and download other apps so it would really mean a lot if you could find a way to make the game less huge. Other than that it's one of my favourite games and I hope you reply to my review!

A very fun game that gives you the choice to play online against other players or versus AI. However it is a bit difficult for new players as most of the playable characters are unavailable and upgrades are expensive. Despite this the story is great and goes through all events in the anime and has characters from the first episode of Dragon Ball to the last episode of the Tournament of Power (ep 131). Some other modes and matches require you to complete a specific story level to unlock them.

Great game but arts boosts kills the game for me (look at reddit and you'll see what I mean). I played this game since release and I played it consistently and very often and found lots of enjoyment. I refuse to grind and waste my life arts boosting units to make them as strong as they were before, it's awful and I cba to play the game. It's killed the game for me so I wouldn't recommend downloading unless you want to spend 900 years grinding

As the big dragon ball fan that i am, i absolutely love this game and spend alot of time playing it, one of my only complaints is how long it takes to grind chrono crystals when there's no story, this really puts me down and not want to play for a while, especially when a new thing comes out like Super Gogetas Zenkai that i now can't do due to lack of crystals, and the price to buy them is extremely expensive. Other than that, this is an amazing game and i 100% recommend it to any DB Fan.

Ok where do i start? This game is the best dragon ball game u can get on mobile forget Dokkan battle. The Plot is simple in dbl egends and the gameplay is 100/10 rating. One important detail i forgot to add that i l know alot of you will like to hear is the fact that is ad free. The events are fun and some are challenging. I have played this game for a while and i have never once thought of deleting it. Download the game. You wont regret. Oh and pack luck might gt bad after while of playing!

This game is super addictive and if you're a Dragonball fan youre definitely gonna love it, the animations are amazing graphics are decent overall a decent game. One thing I do HATE about the game is how it is to get new characters you spend half your day farming chrono crystals (the currency of the game) just to get shafted (not get the new character) so that's why it's a 4 stars for me, try the game out you'll see for yourself.

This game is honestly a lot of work especially if you're going in without a wallet to help. But there now are ways to learn how to fight with the Trunks lecture and you can get chrono crystals from the various exchanges in the exchange shop and events. I would also advise watching how the YouTubers play to understand how the game is best played. Overall it's a very fun game but will take a while to get the hang of.

This game is great, the animation is incredible and there is a lot of quality of life stuff (like a skip button for summons). But, of course, it is a gacha so you need either luck or money to be up to date. This game can also be incredibly frustrating, as it is PVP and almost every time a new unit is released, it becomes impossible to win matches without them. 10/10 would recommend

Great game, great graphics and story mode, lots to do, and many characters to collect. However, it's very hard to get special characters, I've done lots and lots of summons, and I barely get given new characters, in fact for the past 8 weeks I've not recieved one so I can't complet missions, You do get better offers if you buy things, but some people can't afford the price, so it would be nice for the developers to increase the chance to get one, so for now I give up on the game untill they do.

The game is one of the best I have ever played. The pool of characters is constantly increasing with interesting abilities. The game mechanics are fun and simple, but there's a decent curve. The story is really involving and the new character evolving with it is a huge plus. The drop rates for good characters are poor as hell, however. If you don't grind your life away and spend money on it, your team will be mediocre at best.

Live the game. However, there are a few things i dislike of the game. ●there is no comunication between friends or guilds. that hasnt been implemented. ●some missions and events can be very very demanding, especially in a short amount of time. ● Very limited resources such as the way to level friendship rank is almost impossible. training resources are almost never obtained and on through events. ●yhe new star system only made things confusing. i do love this game but i wish a few things fixed.

Unlock simulator at its finest! Not a game to pick up and play for a few minutes; everything is a tutorial or something else you've unlocked. The gameplay is actually pretty cool but it's shut behind walls of daily logins, events, news, new modes and features and by the time you've got through, you're bored.

This game is fantastic! As a dragon ball fan, I personally love this game as a pass timer. It has a solid based story as well as a PvP and training mode, including adventure mode! However a slight nitpick is that there aren't many characters to unlock, there are a few but not too much, as this game has just released I'm expecting new updates with more characters. Great game!!

There is not a lot of mobile games that I rarely enjoy... But Dragonball Legends?? I have found myself coming back to this game, time and time again. Everything from its original story, to the graphics are just beyond breathtaking. Combat in this game is very well done, specifically. It really does feel that you have to use your wits in this team based fighter. As you will use Ki energy quickly if you are not careful. Highly recommended to any Dragonball fan or casual gamers in general! ☺️

This game is fun. But you know what isn't fun. Me going on to db legends and finding out I can't play it. Also the pvp connection is horrible. You can barely even find a match. And some of the times they are weak. Exlcuding them this game is more than good. I have another complaint. I did a multi today, and it crashed before it loaded. This wouldn't be so bad if when I go back on the app, I get no new characters and my crystals are gone.

This game is extremely good with its good graphics, amazing animations, easy gameplay, and of course the amazing characters. Yet there is a major flaw with this game, the microtransactions. As there are many currencies in this game including Zeni and the main type, Chrono Crystals. The fact is that Chrono Crystals cost a lot of money, for example, it costs £40.99 for 2,000 Chrono Crystals and that will only get you 20 summons, and most of the time you will not get any good characters.

So awesome already, its great Update: Still playing and gotta say it's getting so much better over few years the easy life menus and short cuts are soo much better. Makes it easier to use and play. Had to put the rating down one star tho as I'm not sure they realise how much money they are charging for only couple summons. Price is abit much and would never pay that much money.

Game is not bad, the biggest issue with it is that there are plenty of useless low star characters. On top of that its team specific. The story sadly has a few places where you will be stuck only because the enemy hits you hard but you barely do any dmg. Which ruins the experience because even if you boost your main team and give them equipment, you still get beat and it makes 0 difference in the fight. Which is boring, because the fight becomes trial and error at that point.

It's a alright game. It is pay to win tho as your chances of getting a good character are slim, then you need to upgrade that character by getting them even more! The pvp mechanics mean a practiced player can kill you without giving you the chance to do anything. I only play for the story now which I have to wait like 4 months for them to add the next part. Don't spend your money on this game like I did. It isn't worth it.

The game used to be amazing. you finish an event and get 1000 chrono crystals. and now theres just small challenges all over the place. Its too much for me to handle I quit playing this game even tho I got 10 star MUI goku the day he came out and can't get motivated to play new events or pvp anymore. The most fun I had on this game is when the 1st few zenkai characters were released. The least fun I had is when Ultra was released Characters only being cool because they are ultra is a limitation

Would have been 5 out of 5 if this didn't have the worst character drop rates and worst pity system (when chances of good characters increase in rarity the more you attempt to get them). With the pity system PROVEN to be one, if not THE WORST in all of gacha gaming. But over all a good way to have fun and kill time. Just don't expect to get anything amazing at start game...

New Turles update appears to favour those who sink alot of money into the game, locking the character behind random drops which is fine in itself but then we receive an upgrade for only that character which has a 6 day limit to be held and its likely that less than 5% of the player base will find use for this. The game is simple to play and enjoyable and can be played without putting any money in. However high prices placed cronocrystal packs and high cronocrystal price seems unbalanced.

Played this game since the 3rd anniversary, it's good, good graphics, gameplay is fun but for some good awful reason, whenever I do a consecutive summon, it downloads the characters as normal and the. it just crashes, I thought it was just a bug at first, so reopened the game did another consecutive summon and what do you know it crashed again, I uninstalled it and reinstalled it, but nope same problem again, £50 worth of crystals gone to waste. Thanks Bandai.

Good game overall. A few minor issues that a bit of deeper gameplay soon solved. The game can be a bit of a grind but i love DBZ so its fun to do so. I cant really imagine a better control system for combat. Top marks there. Rising rush feels a little overkill a lot off the time but seeing my favourite Z-fighters obliterate a much stronger opponent is still fun.

So I'm changing my review as I've downloaded this game 3 times now....this game is actually really fun it has amazing 3D character models, nice animations, an amazing original game character and his own story. But with every game has its negatives the game once you have hit a certain point is like running into a brick wall there is nothing to do and all bandai do is re-release old and completed events with no way to get the chrono Crystal's unless you cave and pay for them (no more room for fin)

characters in game are a perfect representation of their power and appearance in the series. There are constant refreshing updates with new summons and events in the game, ranked is a work in progress with relatively balanced fights. However the game can be pay to win to speed progress to aid in getting the rare and stronger characters. But still an overall wonderful game.

I like the game but for a 3yr old game it definitely needs work when compared to other mobile games! What's with the constant downloading when I'm playing the same stage? Collecting a reward triggers "connecting.." and I'm back to waiting again. All the abbreviations and story tasks need work! E.g. use goku's special skill. Ok I did that but not passed? Then I realise I have 20 different Gokus in my roster. This review is just within 2 to 3hrs of play.

As a player that's never spent real money on this game- being free2play- I've enjoyed nearly a full year of entertainment. I have no complaints personally, but the playerbase as a whole does have some gripes on certain factors in the game, such as the increasing degree of pay2win the game features. If I had spare $£€, I would most likely be happy to spend some on this game, because it has given me countless hours of fun and I've not spent a penny, as I mentioned. Thanks BandaiNamco!

Genuinely, if you're a Dragon Ball fan you will like this game. It's a great mobile game, sucks you in and has some amazing characters and animations. The gameplay is definitely solid as well, unlike other gachas. However it is a gacha, so expect pay to win aspects in the pvp (fighting other players) scene. But the pve (fighting AIs) scene is also amazing, and will put up a challenge as well. Highly recommend

It is the greatest mobile game ever but the only problem is that you have to grind so much to get chronos crystal and end up buying them which is expensive I just wish that they would care a little more about the people playing the game . Just a little bit easier just a bit P.S: Honestly there idea to make the game addicting and building up the hype (Not like dokkan) is great but then making it hard to get chronos crystal when you are so addicted you have no choice but to buy them. I RATE THAT.

This game is amazing but the only thing I'd change is that it could be a bit harder to train and level up players and a bit easier to get chrono Crystal's like get more of them much faster than you already can and get bigger bunches of them from mission's so you can get better characters and so no matter what summon pack you choose, there's a smaller chance you'd get a hero type

The game was good before the first anniversary, nowadays the game is broken with units such as Vegito Blue, who require no skill to use and is overpowered. The ratings PVP should get rising rushes removed and have a limits to maybe how many Sparkings you can use maybe? The game overall is still pretty good, no ads and it isn't necessarily a game you need to spend money on, but if you don't, you will have to put alot of time and effort into the game only to get shafted most of the time.

I've been playing it for almost a year now and I love the game. But once you complete the main story and event quest, there isnt really much to do to earn crystals. The pack opening by far is my favourite thing in this game, but I feel the odds for getting something good is very low and no where near as rewarding as I should be. Getting the 1000 crystals is hard enough, but not getting any sparkings in the pack is really annoying.

I've reviewed this game before and I'll review it again since the updates. If want a decent fighting game with PvP AND pve, great graphics and an easy to earn in game currency. This is the one. You earn enough currency every 14 days just in daily tasks, to buy a big character pull. Plus free tickets for others. It's like a gatcha. The only issue I have is that I end up maxing out my zeni with nothing to use it on or the ability to scrap it. But other than that, free game, free to play, no ads.

I love this game I've been a huge fan of dragon ball z for a long time and now an amazing company has actually created a game that is like the actuall anime I know all the characters and forms but it impresses me how much drama is in the game. There is a problem, though the game is good the maintenance work is too long and they should make it that they will put news or a notification on your device that says when the maintenance is going to start. Either than that it's an amazing game.

In my personal opinion I've been a fan of dragon ball z for a long time and was waiting for a phone dragon ball z game. And here it is a great quality game with a wide variety of characters to choose from. I mainly like it because it's not to complex for other and if your a starter is gives you daily rewards and a tutorial. I highly recommend this game if you like dragon ball z alot

This games combat is meh and a little hard to get a grasp of but it's so easy for people with lot of money to whale on this game to get maxed out units that break the game, such as the ultra ui sign Goku that disables cover changes (you'll understad soon) and has crazy damage numbers, if you try this game out and play the PvP you'll see what I'm talking about. But it has a lot of redeeming qualities, such as a pretty good story mode, Co-op gamemodes and also really crisp character animations.

The game is great. The graphics, the story, the characters. But I'm getting this weird glitch in PvP once every few games where the screen goes black, and instead of starting the battle it stays black. I wait for a few minutes but nothing happens, so I close and relaunch the app. When I go back to PvP, the match was forfeited by me. This is an issue as I cannot play the PvP mode

This game set a new standard for me. It's my favourite anime in a well developed compatible app that I can't stop playing. My only real complaint is that I wish there were more things to do other than PvP when the event are all completed. My characters are not to the point where I can start playing competitively. So I wish there was some kind of grind that is long and entertaining but not so I have to wait, say 2 days, for me to can continue. This would make this game so satisfying.

Brilliant game, the mechanics are simple yet require strategy. Its not too hard to level up and upgrade and has great graphics and a cool storyline. Only issue i had was when going to the shop and it just crashes but other than that this game is a definite 5 stars EDIT: Right, for all the people complaining about how it is a money grab, summons are a game of luck. There is a 5% sparking chance so dont get your hopes up, i havent spent a single coin on this and i have gogeta perfect cell and goku

Good game BUT. you guys have got some major bugs to fix. Game sometimes doesnt load on the loading screen before a battle AND sometimes the game crashes and closes it self. It's a far cry from dokkan battle too you need to add SO MUCH MORE like the world tournament event and dragon ball wishes. You're WAY behind with characters too. I've spent a little money on the game to kick start my account and still NO GOOD. when you've completed everything theres nothing to do or keep us entertained.

By far the best dragon ball game on mobile. Very user friendly and amazing graphics. If your a DB fan you will love this. As for the people complaining about it being P2W, it's not. Those people just simply need to get better at the game. Legendary and zenkai units aren't hard to deal with if you are somewhat skilled at the game, practice makes perfect. I have spent at total of £30 on this game since its release and I have most of the units and I always make it in the top 1000 every season.

The game itself is good, nice story and quite fun till you reach the PVP where the game puts you into unfair Rating Matches. literally I got into several matches where my opponents power was double compared to me. I believe that should be fixed because it just destroys the Multiplayer side of the game. Other than that it's not that bad.

Amazing Gameplay. But pay to win. You have to collect stones to summon new characters and to strengthen your own further once they reach max potential. Game says 5% drop rate on rare characters(the only ones useful) i spent about £50 summoned around 200 characters so you would expect around 10 rare characters. I received 2. It is soul shattering, lying (about drop rates) money grabbing tactics. I will not spend a penny on this no more and i suggest you guys dont either.

Very good game. I love the pvp and attention to detail in each character. it's very fun to play even if you'r bored. It's fun seeing all the different characters movesets, skills etc. Only issue I have with this game is the fact that I recently couldn't log into my account it showed me "Can't access users data due to terms of service violation" and I didn't do anything at all I hope this is some kind of bug because it's really frustrating that I spent 2300 hours on this game please do something

Games great. It has good graphics, a decent story and good monthly or weekly updates depending on the character. But as time went on it encouraged you to spend money and buy resources. I've never spent money on this game but sometimes I have to stop playing and wait for a seasonal reward because there are no rewards for the story. They're very accurate with the anime and I love all the rarities of characters and there appearances. Used to be. 5stars but now 4

totally brilliant version of dragon ball, can be a bit confusing at first but can get the hang of the game quite quickly. decent for rattling away free time or just going for a marathon session. do not be dissapointed about not getting the card you want like the others do....since it is only a chance that you will, it is the same for the other games that have summonable characters; you will eventually get the card you want :)
amazing game made my childhood also f2p is a bit hard but overall ts is op

Fun gameplay, amazing graphics and a wide range of characters. I would like them to add more levels to story mode and make it more rewarding. Also add a more secure way of get cc as after finishing the story you have to do ALOT of work just for one rotation. Finally, add a pity system e.g after 3 rotations you are guaranteed o get a featured character.

Best dragon ball game on mobile in my opinion. I love the combat system and the events are fun (most of the time😶) you can't get bored (unless you get shafted and lose all of your cc) the probelm is the main feature of the game p2w, I don't mind it but when my painfully built team gets swept by a no skill p2w it's really annoying, other than that I'm okay with everything, and I'm fine with the gacha system because it wouldn't be fun if it was easy, 4 out of 5 for me

I have been playing this game from launch and honestly it's really good the animation and design of the game for a mobile game is really good. But do beware there is a lot of grind for the currency that is needed to pull more characters and it might get frustrating at times cause of the type of game this is but if you like DB or fighting games than this is a good one to pick up, you just have to be really patience with it then you will enjoy it.

This game is a great skilled based fighting game where you use special cards to attack the opponent. You can summon characters which have extra cards and the currency is quite easy to earn until you get far into the game. The story is great and rewards you with a free character which is better than most summonable characters, and he gets upgraded as you complete the story. He is also customisable as you can change his ultimate attack, clothing and transformation. 10/10

Dragon Ball Legends is a fast-paced mobile fighting game featuring iconic characters from the Dragon Ball series. With real-time combat and card-based mechanics, players can battle through story mode or engage in PvP. The game offers a unique narrative with original character Shallot, though the gacha system can feel grindy. Overall, it’s a fun experience for Dragon Ball fans, but in-app purchases may be a drawback for some.

Animations are great. Characters kits, especially the newer ones are really good too. Only problem is the game's lack of consideration for the older F2P Players. If it releases more events from which the valuable ingame currency Chrono Crystals(CC) can be amassed, like a Chrono Crystal bonus battle or a high difficulty event that can be played repeatedly without skip tickets. I think such things would immensely boost the game's potential and allow everyone to enjoy the game to its fullest!

This game is hands down the best dragon ball game on moblie though it still has its flaws. Probably the only gotcha games where free to play is definetely an option. I've been playing well over a year now and I've thoroughly enjoyed it. It's got the typical RNG annoyances with the summons, but the frequent events make up for it. The graphics and animations are great, and the gameplay is fun and has more depth than you might first realise. A fantastic game if you're a Dragon Ball fan, still a very good one if you're not.

In short, it's fun, there are FAR worse dragonball games, and that this is f2p is an added bonus. The interface could use some work, the top up event display every time you log in that you need to tap through could be so much more efficient. Microtransactions are present, and not great value for money, but I've not once felt the desire to pay anything in my time playing. Overall, give it a go, if you have a reasonably powerful phone, plenty of battery, and you like the dragonball universe.
